rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF FILOMENA A DALOPE
rulings.Calendar Matter: ACCOUNTING PETITION RE: Report, Fees, Final Distribution
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 8/26/2026 for the following issues to be explained or cleared: (1) The petition requests distribution to the testamentary trust under Articles Third and Fourth but does not fully incorporate the trust terms. Article Third omits sections (E) and (F), referencing them only as "...". Article Fourth includes only section (A), excluding (B) through (H). Please provide an allegation addressing whether the proposed distribution meets the requirements of CRC 7.650(b). (2) Also, the omnibus clause in prayer #6 does not set a $3,500,000 limit on property discovered later for distribution to the testamentary trust under Article Third. Once the amount is capped, the distribution to the testamentary trust should be made in accordance with Article Fourth.

rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE CHECCHI FAMILY REVOCABLE TRUST, DTD APRIL 3, 2003
rulings.Calendar Matter: Petition For Appointment Of Successor Trustee Due To Vacancy
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/23/2026 (no earlier date available). The following notes were e-mailed to counsel on 07/31/2026: 1) Notice must be given to the attorney for Brandy Lopez, Andrea Lopez, Damone Lopez, and Sabrina Lopez, absent a signed waiver. 2) A bond waiver signed by each beneficiary must be filed. See Probate Code section 15602(a)(3) & (b). The waiver must comply with LRSF 14.16(H) by including the same language as used on the Judicial Council form DE-142. 3) If bond waivers cannot be obtained from all beneficiaries, a supplement verified by petitioner must be filed to state the market value of the trust assets on hand, together with the probable annual gross income therefrom, as the Court may require the proposed successor trustee to give a bond as a condition of her appointment. See LRSF 14.16(G).

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF ELIZABETH M. MORRIS
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/14/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) If a will names a trust or trustee as a devisee, the trustee(s) must be clearly identified in item 8. Where the personal representative and the sole trustee are the same person, or if there is no trustee, the beneficiaries of the trust must be clearly identified (Probate Code Section 1208(b) and LRSF 14.18.C.2). 2) Item 8 lists the Endowment and Development Fund of the International Brotherhood of Magicians as a "possible beneficiary". Please clarify what that means and explain any ambiguities surrounding this institution. 3) All notices must include language about remote appearances (San Francisco Local Rule 14.1.C.6). Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/31/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
